messages:
Lina CSM: Heads-up — ACME onboarding shows a 3x spike in embeddings calls over the last 7d and has started hitting budget alerts. Need a short pre-renewal health check + enablement follow-up.
Omar (FinOps): Can you drop last 30d spend and top workflows? I can do a quick burn breakdown.
Lina CSM: Dropping a quick query you can run if you have access:
```
SELECT account, sum(token_count) as tokens, sum(cost_usd) as cost
FROM usage
WHERE account='acme' AND ts >= now() - interval '30 days'
GROUP BY account;
```
Devon (SE): Noted — looks like the indexer job is doing long-context embeddings (chunk size ~= 2048). Probable cause for bursty tokens. If so, recommend prefix caching + smaller chunking for ingestion. Will pull logs.
cost-alert-bot: [alert] acme account exceeded 75% of monthly budget threshold (trigger: embeddings-heavy policy).
Julie (Enablement): I can run a 20min ridealong/demo next Tue to show batching, chunking, and prompt reformats to cut tokens.
Omar (FinOps): Ran a quick calc: 30d tokens = ~1.2B, extrapolated month = ~1.6B, est monthly cost = $4.8k. With batching + KV cache realistic cut = ~25–35% which is material.
Lina CSM: Good data — can we turn this into an enablement checklist and a short customer note? Also want to capture why they're using long contexts (ingestion pipeline vs interactive use).
Devon (SE): I'll author a tiny RFC for runtime knob defaults and telemetry keys. Draft snippet:
```
cache_ttl: 600  # seconds
batch_size: 8
embed_chunk_size: 1024
```
Lina CSM: Action items: 1) Julie — run demo Tue 2pm PT & send checklist to ACME; 2) Devon — RFC + telemetry to detect indexer pattern; 3) Omar — publish spend forecast and recommend alert thresholds; 4) Lina — draft feedback questions and schedule renewal-health sync.
Julie (Enablement): Tue 2pm PT works. I'll prep slides + a short checklist they can follow.
Omar (FinOps): I'll post the spend forecast breakdown and recommended alert tweaks in here by EOD.
Lina CSM: Thanks all — I'll ping the ACME contact with proposed times once Julie confirms. Closing loop after demo. :thumbsup:
